measurement_semantics.environment_observed_role: Endpoint, distance, and hold fields are sampled from the live environment after env.step and retain task semantics.

kinematic_reference.role: Forward-consistent reference only; it does not replace environment-observed endpoint, distance, or hold fields.
kinematic_reference.source: Separate MuJoCo replay loaded from qpos_after_rad and qvel_after_rad_s, followed by mj_forward and mj_jacSite.

units.time: control steps; ten simulator substeps per control step
